$comment: Consumed by .github/workflows/hf-kernel-publish.yml via scripts/szl_kernel_publish.py. This repository is the single source of the Hub kernel repo SZLHOLDINGS/szl-formulas and the only writer of it and of its model-repo twin. Kernel major (version) is the v<major> API channel, not the package version 0.1.0.

kernels.name: szl-formulas
kernels.$why_prune_paths: Hub-only plates seen on kernel main 5cac04af (2026-10-14): OPERATIONAL.json and BENCH.laptop-blackwell.json are 2026-08-29 laptop plates (github_sha 977f344c) that advertise revision="main" with kernels 0.16.1; SZL_SOURCE_BINDING.json is the retired runtime lane's binding (source fca97079), superseded by SZL_KERNEL_SOURCE.json. Kernel v1 39a9fe6f carries none of them.

model_twin.$why_prune_paths: Seen on model main 7a8ae79e (2026-10-14). build/ is never loaded by kernels>=0.16 and serves the stale fca97079 package; the plates and binding are the same stale files as on the kernel repo; scripts/ (eval.py, forge.py), tests/ (test_formulas.py) and build.toml are stale code/config copies that differ from GitHub; torch-ext/ and model.joblib stay absent (absent today, kept absent). BOM, receipts, provenance, audit, SECURITY.md, LICENSE, SZL_ESTATE_MANAGED.json and the card art are kept.
